snippet.description:
Stuck at 200–220 marks in Sociology Optional despite having studied the syllabus and solved previous year questions?

In this video, Nishat Sir explains one of the biggest reasons aspirants struggle to break the 200-mark barrier in UPSC Sociology Optional.

UPSC often repeats themes and questions from previous years. But when a familiar question appears, many students get excited because they know the topic and end up writing everything they have studied about it — while missing the actual demand of the question.

The result? Even with repeated questions, the answer may not match what the examiner is looking for.

Nishat Sir explains why understanding the demand of the question, rather than simply reproducing your knowledge, is crucial for improving your Sociology Optional score.

If you're preparing for UPSC CSE and struggling to move beyond 200–220 marks in Sociology Optional, this video is for you.
